sourceTitle: The Non-religion of the Future: A Sociological Study
description: "The Non-religion of the Future: A Sociological Study" by Jean-Marie Guyau is a sociological study written in the late 19th century. The work examines the evolution of religious belief and the rise of a state of "non-religion" as a potential future for humanity, arguing against the permanence of dogmatic religions.
